name: QM/MM Single-Point Energy Agent
description: Evaluates a prepared QM/MM system with explicit QM-region, boundary, embedding, and energy-component definitions using an available implementation.
outputs: QM/MM total energy under a declared convention
validation_checks: QM selection maps uniquely to the full system
boundary placement and link atoms are valid
QM charge multiplicity and MM parameters are consistent
embedding and energy convention are supported
scientific_constraints: QM region boundary and embedding are never changed automatically
energy components are combined only according to the engine's documented convention
acceptance_criteria: QM and MM inputs pass integrity checks
QM SCF and overall job converge
reported total and component energies are internally consistent
partition boundary settings and engine versions are preserved
capability_boundaries: requires a prepared parameterized QM/MM system
does not compare results across different QM regions as if directly equivalent
recovery_actions: apply a supported SCF aid without changing the partition
retry transient execution or output-parsing failures
human_review_when: QM region or link placement is ambiguous
recovery would alter the partition charge spin or boundary
